flags.reason: The guide gives no doDont guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

misreads-source: The evidence says the opposite: subscriptionContent adds the third column when React.Children.count > 0, and "`false`, `''` or an empty fragment still add an empty column". The fact says they hide the column like `null`.

misreads-source: This rests on the wrong /facts/props/9. The evidence (and its Discrepancies: "`subscriptionContent={false}` shows an empty column") says false, '' or an empty fragment still render an empty Subscriptions column. Limits also say not to show `subscriptionContent={false}`.

misreads-source: The evidence says "Without actions the empty group still takes a 20 px gap", with a no-actions height of 227 because "the empty group's 20 px gap remains". The fact claims omitted or empty actions "leave no group and no extra gap".

misreads-source: This contradicts the guide: "Without actions, the empty row still adds 20 px at the bottom". doDont also lists "Leave out actions" as a Don't, because "An empty row still leaves space under the fine print." The item recommends leaving actions out and claims no extra gap.

lost-context: It recommends a second action without the guide's caveat that "with two, the longer label is cut short". doDont lists "Two actions" as a Don't ("The row splits equally, so View details is cut short").

misreads-source: The guide says "the card adds the ₹" and that the ₹ is fixed, and doDont says a ₹ in the price "shows ₹₹349". The evidence says there are no currency props. A currency prop that avoids double prefixing contradicts the guide for the installed 0.1.78.
misreads-source: The guide says "the labels Validity, Data, and Subscriptions are fixed", and the evidence says there are no label props. Limits: "Don't imply the currency or labels can change".
misreads-source: The guide says the Data label is fixed, and the evidence says there are no label props.
misreads-source: The guide says the Subscriptions label is fixed, and the evidence says there are no label props.

misreads-source: The guide's sources section says "a card without onPress isn't announced by its title". The evidence says "Static: `accessibilityLabel` only (title not used)". "pressable or not; without it, the card is named by its title" contradicts both.

misreads-source: The guide says disabled "stops it firing without changing its look" and "disabled has no look of its own". Limits: "Don't show `disabled` as a visual state". The item says the card is dimmed, even when static.

The guide and its evidence were checked on 20 October on 0.1.78-c7d3348. The installed build, dbe0e02, carries most of #353's fixes: the buttons hug their labels, no actions means no row and no gap, a ₹ already in the price is not doubled, currency and label props exist, an empty subscriptionContent hides the column, disabled dims the card, and a static card is named by its title. This entry follows the installed package and leaves out the guide sentences dbe0e02 contradicts, including all three Do and Don't pairs. dbe0e02 also brought #416: actions that don't fit the row run past the card's edge. Re-extract once #353 and #416 are fixed and the guide is re-checked and published. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch3, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Plans on the Recharge screen, one under another under a Title: the Unlimited 5G plan with the apps it includes (monogram Avatars stand in for app logos, as in the guide) and a Data pack without apps. Each Recharge starts the screen's own payment through the Button's onPress (stubs here); the card only lays out the plan.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Popular plans" subtitle="For 98765 43210" />
  <RechargeCard
    title="Unlimited 5G"
    price={349}
    validity="28 days"
    data="2 GB/day"
    disclaimer={'Unlimited voice and 100 SMS a day.\nSpeed drops to 64 kbps after 2 GB.'}
    subscriptionContent={
      <>
        <Avatar style="Monogram" monogram="JH" />
        <Avatar style="Monogram" monogram="JS" />
        <Avatar style="Monogram" monogram="+2" />
      </>
    }
    actions={<Button label="Recharge" onPress={() => {}} />}
  />
  <RechargeCard
    title="Data pack"
    price={19}
    validity="1 day"
    data="1.5 GB"
    disclaimer="Data only. No voice or SMS."
    actions={<Button label="Recharge" onPress={() => {}} />}
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: Each Recharge starts the screen’s own payment through the Button’s onPress; the card only lays out the plan.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the card. Default: "Unlimited 5G". Default "Unlimited 5G", from the component source.

props.name: price
props.description: Value for the MoneyValue component. Default: 500. Default 500, from the component source.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol or ISO code prefixed to `price`. Default: "₹". A string `price` that already starts with this symbol (or `₹` when the currency is INR) is not prefixed again. Default "₹", from the component source.

props.name: validity
props.description: Validity duration string. Default: "365 days". Default "365 days", from the component source.

props.name: data
props.description: Data allowance string. Default: "2 GB/Day". Default "2 GB/Day", from the component source.

props.name: validityLabel
props.description: Label above the validity value. Default: "Validity". Default "Validity", from the component source.

props.name: dataLabel
props.description: Label above the data value. Default: "Data". Default "Data", from the component source.

props.name: subscriptionsLabel
props.description: Label above the subscription avatars. Default: "Subscriptions". Default "Subscriptions", from the component source.

props.name: disclaimer
props.default:
Data only pack (No Voice & No SMS)
Voice: NA | SMS: NA...
props.description: Disclaimer text under the specs. Default: "Data only pack (No Voice & No SMS)\\nVoice: NA | SMS: NA...". Default "Data only pack (No Voice & No SMS)\nVoice: NA | SMS: NA...", from the component source.

props.name: subscriptionContent
props.description: Wrapped in an AvatarGroup at Avatar Size S whatever the card's modes: 29 px Avatars, overlapping by 6 px. Declared: Avatar elements to be displayed in the subscription slot. Content will be wrapped in an AvatarGroup. `false`, `''` and an empty fragment hide the column the same way as `null`.

props.name: actions
props.description: The Buttons get AppearanceBrand Secondary (purple), Button / Size S and Emphasis High, with the card's modes on top; a Button's own modes win. Declared: Actions to be displayed in the button group (e.g. Button components). Buttons should be passed as children to this prop. Omitted, `false`, `''` or an empty fragment leave no group and no extra gap.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The root becomes a Pressable with the button role, named by accessibilityLabel or else title. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the card and blocks the pressable wrapper when `onPress` is set. The dimmed look applies even on a static card.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label forwarded to the root (defaults to `title`).

modes.name: Avatar Size
modes.description: Has no effect on the card's Avatars: the card forces them to S. Declared: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Badge Size
modes.description: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context2
modes.description: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context3
modes.description: The card gives its price Context3 Balance & Cards by default: 36 px, weight 900. Context3 Default on the card shrinks the price to 14 px. Declared: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context4
modes.description: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Page type
modes.description: A token collection RechargeCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: subscriptionContent
slots.description: Avatar elements to be displayed in the subscription slot. Content will be wrapped in an AvatarGroup. `false`, `''` and an empty fragment hide the column the same way as `null`.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Actions to be displayed in the button group (e.g. Button components). Buttons should be passed as children to this prop. Omitted, `false`, `''` or an empty fragment leave no group and no extra gap.

events.name: onPress
events.description: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

gaps.text: The card is 271 px tall where Figma's is 261 (three columns, one action, 312 px wide), because its text lines are taller: line heights are raised to 1.2 × the font size.
Figma's Recharge Card exposes only title and disclaimer as properties; the price, facts, apps and buttons are layers there.
